# `add` command

Add a dependency to the fobos, resolved through the package indexes (the fobos gets its URL).

```bash
fobis add NAME|INDEX:NAME|URL [options]
```

How to use it, with examples: [Packages and indexes](/cookbook/packages#add-a-dependency-by-name).

## All options

Arguments: `PACKAGE`

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--module` | TEXT |  | Add the package providing this module. |
| `--as` | TEXT |  | Name of the dependency in the fobos. |
| `--semver` | TEXT |  | Version range (default: ^ the newest). |
| `--tag` | TEXT |  | Pin a tag. |
| `--rev` | TEXT |  | Pin a commit. |
| `--branch` | TEXT |  | Follow a branch. |
| `--use` | TEXT |  | sources (compiled with yours, default) or fobos (built apart). |
| `--mode`, `-m` | TEXT |  | Mode of the dependency's fobos (use=fobos). |
| `--dev` |  |  | A test-only dependency. |
| `--force` |  |  | Replace an existing dependency of that name. |
| `--fobos`, `-f` | TEXT | `fobos` | The fobos to edit. |
| `--fpm` |  |  | Edit fpm.toml (the default when the project has one and no fobos). |
| `--config` | TEXT |  | User configuration file (default ~/.config/fobis/config.ini). |
| `--depth` | INTEGER | `2` | How far 'follows' is walked (0: configured indexes only). |
| `--refresh` |  |  | Fetch the indexes again instead of using the cache. |
| `--json` |  |  | Machine-readable output. |
